description: This file defines the XVector struct, which represents a two-dimensional vector in the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace. It includes properties, methods, and operator overloads for vector arithmetic, normalization, transformation, and string conversion.

classes.name: XVector
classes.description: A struct representing a 2D vector with X and Y components, including vector arithmetic, normalization, and transformation methods.

methods.name: XVector
methods.description: Constructor initializing a vector with specified X and Y components.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Checks equality of two vectors.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two vectors.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines if this vector equals another vector.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Creates a vector from its string representation.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the vector.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the vector to a unit vector.

methods.name: CrossProduct
methods.description: Calculates the cross product of two vectors.

methods.name: AngleBetween
methods.description: Returns the angle in degrees between two vectors.

methods.name: Negate
methods.description: Negates the vector.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds two vectors.

methods.name: Subtract
methods.description: Subtracts one vector from another.

methods.name: operator + (XVector, XPoint)
methods.description: Translates a point by a vector.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies a vector by a scalar.

methods.name: Divide
methods.description: Divides a vector by a scalar.

methods.name: operator *(XVector, XMatrix)
methods.description: Transforms a vector using a matrix.

methods.name: operator *(XVector, XVector)
methods.description: Calculates the dot product of two vectors.

methods.name: Determinant
methods.description: Calculates the determinant of two vectors.

methods.name: Explicit operator XSize
methods.description: Converts a vector to a Size object.

methods.name: Explicit operator XPoint
methods.description: Converts a vector to a Point.
